items.title: Consent to rent increase under § 558b BGB due
items.quote: Diesen Brief hat mein Sohn am 18. November 2026 um 10:30 Uhr bei Ihnen eingeworfen.
items.computation: The letter was personally hand-delivered (eingeworfen) by the landlord's son on 18 November 2026 at 10:30, so receipt (Zugang) is 18 November 2026 itself - no postal delivery-fiction days apply since this was direct hand delivery during normal daytime hours. Under § 558b Abs. 2 BGB, the tenant must consent to a rent increase request by the end of the second calendar month following receipt. The calendar month of receipt is November 2026; the first following calendar month is December 2026; the second following calendar month is January 2027, so the period ends with the expiry (Ablauf) of January 2027, i.e. 31 January 2027. Checking that date: 1 January 2027 falls on a Friday (derived from 1 January 2026 being a Thursday, 2026 being a non-leap year), so 31 January 2027 falls on a Sunday. Since this is a declaration (Zustimmung) deadline, § 193 BGB extends the end of the period to the next working day, which is Monday, 1 February 2027 (not a public holiday in Hessen).

items.title: New (increased) net cold rent takes effect
items.quote: Ich bitte Sie, der Erhöhung Ihrer Nettokaltmiete von 480,00 € auf 545,00 € (7,90 € je m² bei 69 m²) ab dem 01.02.2027 zuzustimmen.
items.computation: The landlord states explicitly that the increased net cold rent of 545,00 € should apply from 01.02.2027. This matches the statutory rule of § 558b Abs. 1 BGB that, if timely consent is given, the increased rent is owed from the beginning of the third calendar month after receipt of the request (receipt 18 November 2026 → third following calendar month begins 1 February 2027). Date taken as printed in the letter.

warnings: The letter itself does not quote a sentence stating the exact legal consent deadline; it was calculated from the stated hand-delivery date (18 November 2026, 10:30) using the statutory rule of § 558b Abs. 2 BGB and should be verified against the tenant's actual date of receipt.
